raw_segments.text: We will, of course, not reproduce his account of what is known to the reader already.
Midia was impatiently anxious not to omit the slightest detail.
At the same time, he was in a hurry to get it over.
But as he gave his evidence, it was written down, and therefore they had continually to
Midia disliked this, but submitted, got angry, though still good-humoredly.
He did, it is true, exclaim from time to time,
Gentlemen, that's enough to make an angel out of patience.
Or, Gentlemen, it's no good you're irritating me.
